cgroupV2.ancestorVisibility: Only ancestors exposed by this mount and cgroup namespace are observed. Hidden or unreadable ancestor limits and other workloads may reduce CPU capacity; max is not proof of unlimited capacity.

method.scope: Repeated small jobs, fresh queue per job, same warmed worker pool within each sample; fresh process per sample.
method.timing: Sum of monotonic intervals from before submit to final commit and file guard; includes submission, scheduler creation, claims, computation, JSON transport, ordered single-row commits and SQLite file-size checks.
method.excluded: Build, process startup, pool warmup, database open/migration, scheduler stop, result verification/export, database close/removal and gaps between jobs.
method.warmup: Each round concurrently fills all worker slots with workload rows; no queue warmup. Worker startup is in warmupMs.
method.ordering: Repetition rotates worker counts and workload/backend combinations; all samples run sequentially.
method.verification: Every stored NDJSON row is read after timing; cursor/count and full digest must match serial execution of the same engine build. This is parity, not accuracy evidence.
method.failurePolicy: Report every sample. Failed groups have no throughput summary or speedup. Retries invalidate a sample. A child timeout or crash records a failure.
method.counterScope: In-process counters use acknowledged snapshots, which may lag storage after an uncertain error. After child failure all counters are unavailable, represented by zero with counterScope=unavailable-after-child-failure.
method.storage: SQLite defaults (WAL, FULL synchronous) on this filesystem; each job uses a fresh file. Memory uses the same job shapes. No live Redis benchmark.
method.limitations: Small-job scaling does not establish large-single-job throughput, HTTP/CLI throughput, continuous service throughput, cold start latency, host power-loss durability or exclusive CPU availability.
